timing_scope: Matching only: batch dispatch, routing, signature checks, service priority/deduplication and result storage. Preparation/JSON/normalization/output excluded. Ordinary medians are separate from profiled runs.
hardware_scope: CPU counters EL0 and worker-only. Time-series ratios are clipped to sampled matching; L1D counts cover worker lifetimes. VM samples bracket worker lifetimes at 10ms and CPU is converted from Mach ticks. These ratios are not wall-time percentages.
limits: No hard CPU affinity; worker count is not physical-core pinning.
Native DRAM bandwidth and L2 miss counters were not measured.
Kernel stack addresses are unresolved; system CPU cannot be assigned exactly to a named compressor function.
VM deltas are system-wide; target faults/pageins and resident bytes are process-specific.
Preparation can compress normalized input pages; first-touch restoration is included in matching.

selectivity.condition_mapping_method: Original Rust plan_groups on the unchanged rule database in a temporary source copy; every group ID and ordered rule ID list checked against each recorded profile.
limits: Calls are counted after routing and group byte/length guards, not before those guards.
Confirmation means at least one rule ID from a called group before ResultBuilder; not attack-detection precision.
Group-call and contained-rule counts are not individual regex execution counts.
Per-request percentiles of selected groups were not recorded; only the mean is available.

quick_ablation.experiment: Short warmed single-thread matcher+ResultBuilder ablation; no worker scheduler, I/O or preparation in timing.
quick_ablation.sample_method: Up to 12 sorted Legitimate and 3 sorted Malicious JSON files of 50 KB–2 MiB; per-file prefix quotas; requests capped at 64 KiB and total at 16 MiB.
limitations: Nonrandom size-limited sample; large requests excluded.
Repeated warmed inputs; not comparable to full-corpus fresh-process seconds.
Group layout, byte/length guards and result semantics preserved.
Ablation overlays apply only to a temporary source copy; production matcher unchanged.
reproduction_notes: Release dependencies must already be present under target/release/deps.
In a new temporary directory save source_archive.temporary_driver_py as run.py and create root.json containing the repository root under the root key.
Run python3 -B run.py from the repository root; source overlays and executable remain in the temporary directory.
The archived driver describes the 2026-10-14 experiment and does not update repository measurements.
